items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: She replaced me in California. And when they came back, she came back with them.

ctx.x: Oh, did we go there before?
Somebody told me once there was a lady out there whom I knew once. Even made some records with her in Bunk Johnson. Bertha Gonsolin.
Well, that's afterwards. I'll get to there.
